crossRefs.note: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of…
Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.
He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
He dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city.…

translations.web: These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
translations.bsb: These were the men who served the king, besides those he stationed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.
translations.kjv: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.
translations.asv: These were they that waited on the king, besides those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
